title: PR #59 Change Records retained stale pre-push delivery wording
summary: PR #65 corrected the two then-current PR #59 Change Records, merged normally as 1fa024ca6ec97023ea5b6f7dff5215e43f10b74c, and is reachable from current master. PR #227 later intentionally retired the two individual reports. The current tree retains only the bilingual change-record archive README pair, publishes no stale Draft/no-integration wording, and preserves traceability in Git history, commits, and pull requests. This is a closed documentation finding, not a product-security finding.

PR #227 retirierte die zwei einzelnen Reports später absichtlich. The current reader-facing tree must not publish the stale Draft/no-integration wording; archival traceability must remain available through the bilingual archive README, Git history, commits, and pull requests.

impact: The former records could have caused readers to misinterpret delivery state. The corrected reports were subsequently retired, so no current reader-facing in-tree copy retains the stale wording. No product-security boundary, runtime behavior, secret, or deployed control is affected.
impact_de: Die früheren Records konnten Leser den Delivery-Status fehlinterpretieren lassen. Die korrigierten Reports wurden anschließend retirert, sodass keine aktuelle leserorientierte In-Tree-Kopie die veraltete Formulierung behält.
